item.title: Version 0.8.4
item.description:
What's New

  • Pro: Chinese wallpaper names, descriptions, controls and Workshop preset names can be machine-translated into the app language; Settings has a Translate wallpaper text switch and a language pack download
  • Pro: a downloading Workshop item shows how many bytes have arrived
  • Pro: you can select and cancel subscription downloads, and batch downloads run one at a time
  • A wallpaper that fails to load lists the missing files and names the likely cause
  • Settings has a new Appearance page for window and library appearance
  • In the detail sheet, pressing a display that already shows the wallpaper opens that display's page

Improvements

  • The Storage page shows both rings with a full-name legend, lists every location with its path and actions, and can clear preview, shader, audio and web caches
  • Pro: library entries whose Workshop items Steam deleted are removed after each SteamCMD run

Bug Fixes

  • Pro: scene scripts receive cursor input again, and parallax, cursor regions and audio-driven particle rates work again
  • Pro: clock highlights no longer turn white, and transparent layers no longer get darker
  • Pro: 3D models keep their own material per mesh, translucent parts stay blended, and padded textures no longer show seams
  • Pro: lights under text and top-level particles, sprite UVs and text effects render closer to Windows
  • Pro: textures with conditional variants load and show their base image
  • Pro: Sync subscribed wallpapers no longer reports every subscription as missing
  • Pro: removing Steam-deleted items no longer touches items that are downloading, moved, or in a renamed Steam library
  • A wallpaper applied while displays connect or disconnect is no longer lost
  • A paused video keeps its seek position
  • Clearing caches skips files that are still in use
  • The title-bar double-click setting is honored

Not notarized — if macOS refuses to open the app, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Loomscreen Pro.app" once; updates Loomscreen Pro installs itself clear the flag. Full release notes · 完整发布说明
